items.title: Design
items.text: You see how the site looks on phone and computer, and give feedback.

items.title: Build
items.text: We build the pages, add your content and test everything.

items.title: Launch and support
items.text: We put the site online and stay available to fix problems.

blocks.heading: Search-ready from day one
blocks.text: We build the basics that search engines look for: fast pages, a layout that works on phones, clear headings and page titles. This gives your website a good start. Nobody can promise a place on Google, and we do not. If you want more visitors, our digital marketing service can help.

price.heading: What a website costs
price.text: The price depends on the type of site, the number of pages and the features you need. See our website packages, or tell us your plan and we send a quote.

crossSell.title: Prefer to pay monthly?
crossSell.text: Get a ready website with hosting, updates and support included, and pay each month.

crossSell.title: Need software, not a website?
crossSell.text: We build custom software for the way your business works.

items.q: How much does a website cost in Nepal?
items.a: It depends on the type of site, the pages and the features. Our packages are on the pricing page in NPR and USD. For online shops and portals, tell us your plan and we send a quote.

items.q: Will my website work on mobile phones?
items.a: Yes. We design for phones first, then for larger screens, and we check the site on phones before launch. Pages are kept light so they open quickly on a basic phone.

form.heading: Tell us about your website
form.text: Tell us what you need. We reply with a clear plan and quote.
